unsupported.why: FACT: Điều 80 sets effect from 19/08/2026; Điều 55 khoản 1 điểm b penalises not sending the processing-impact dossier to that Cục; the end counts show A05 0 times in Law 91, Decree 356 and Decree 330; Điều 39 khoản 1 leaves the specialised agency unnamed. minor.why: FACT: khoản 3 điểm a requires thực phẩm bảo vệ sức khỏe ads to carry the exact warning that the product is not a medicine and has no effect of replacing thuốc chữa bệnh. 'A supplement ad ... does not replace medicine' is a shorter, slightly stronger paraphrase.

verdict.notes: Eight of nine paragraphs stay inside their anchors. Decree 330 copy guidance offers the Cục full name as a stand-in for the specialised agency; no shown sentence equates them, and the A05 counts do not prove that absence. The supplement disclaimer paraphrase is minor. Historical and MED002 lines are labelled.
